card.name: Linking words before statin or fibrate names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or brackets (with, taking, to, as, an opening quote) right before a lipid-lowering drug such as a statin or fibrate is named. Seen in interaction and myopathy warnings.

modes.label: Co-administration link
modes.description: The word 'with' after co-administered or co-administration, just before a statin or other drug.
modes.example: observational studies indicate that the risk for rhabdomyolysis is increased when fibrates, including fenofibrates, are co-administered<< with>> a statin.

modes.label: Bracket before statins
modes.description: An opening bracket or quote just after a drug class name, before 'statins'.

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: Words like taking, to, or as that lead into a named interacting drug class.
modes.example: in those<< taking>> corticosteroid or fluoroquin
